incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed multi-story building with debris scattered around, showing significant structural damage, with other buildings and vegetation visible in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily damaged, with its upper floors collapsed and materials scattered on the ground.
A tall, vertical pole is standing in the foreground, and parts of other buildings are visible in the background.
A green tree is visible behind the rubble, along with some shrubs.
A white sack is placed on a concrete base in the foreground.

not_determinable: water depth or presence of flooding
